           Latah Super Early Tomatoes - 2x Plug Plant - UK Climate Bush Tomato
          





           Early Latah Bush Tomato Plug Plants - Best for UK Outdoors
           


           Specially bred for UK outdoor growing, even in cooler summers
           

           Produces heavy crops of thin-skinned, full-flavoured, golf ball-sized tomatoes
           

           Very early ripening and crops over a long period
           

           Easy to grow - no pinching out required
           

           Grows as a sprawling bush with lots of fruiting sideshoots
           

           Sideshoots may need support; tie to a central stake or use a fruit cage to keep fruit off the ground
           

           You will receive healthy plug plants, ready to plant out after the last frost. Perfect for reliable outdoor tomato harvests in the UK.
